about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME
It all began on a windy October night in 1999.
Evelyn Strom received a text message from her brother Adam, a message that would change her life and the life of countless others.

Lost Traces: Unsolved Cases - Genesis is the first installment of a new adventure Saga. Get a first-hand experience of the fateful night that set everything in motion!

Who are we
We are Sitting Ducks Productions, a new indie studio from Europe, and this is our first project out of many.
This game is a dream come true for everyone in our studio and will set in motion the beginning of the development of the Lost Traces Saga. At this stage, we focus mostly on this one project, which is in fact a life’s work for our Lead Developer, Game Designer, writer, and sole creator, Stavros Theologou, who for the past 7 years set his mind, vision, and gaming experience to paper by creating a story worthy of a Saga. Alongside him, stands a team of friends and family, full of passion for gaming and creativity both in visuals and voice acting.

Explore and Investigate
Experience the beginning of the "Lost Traces" series through the eyes of Evelyn Strom in an immersive first-person view with full 3D sound. Explore and collect clues about the "Lost Traces" universe, collect key items, tools and notes to assist you in the search for Evelyn’s brother and help you unravel the mystery of what is really going on.
But remember, what we fear usually lurks in the dark. Trust your instincts.

Unreal Engine 5.4
We put a lot of emphasis on graphics, sounds, and the atmosphere as a whole. With realistic yet retro vibes inspired by old point-and-click adventure horror games while harnessing the power of Unreal Engine 5.4

This is the Beginning of the Saga!

A Note on Development & Creative Tools

*Lost Traces: False Awakening* - *Lost Traces: Genesis* is a passion project developed by a **small, dedicated indie team**. To achieve the large, complex scope of this world efficiently, we selectively utilized commercially licensed, pre-generated tools in our development pipeline.

This usage is limited and purposeful:

* **Character Designs (Images):** Some early character design concepts, used in promotional media and the game, were initially inspired or informed by image generation tools like **Stable Diffusion**. Every single piece of content has since been **extensively and manually edited, refined, and painted** by our artists to ensure high artistic quality and unique visual identity.

* **Voice Dialogue (Audio):** A small portion of the in-game voice dialogue was generated using licensed text-to-speech or AI tools. This audio was then run through **professional editing, mastering, and processing** to integrate it seamlessly into the game's soundscape.

Our team maintains **full creative and artistic control** over all final assets. We believe this careful use of technology allows us to deliver a richer, larger world than would otherwise be possible with our limited resources, while still ensuring a unique, hand-crafted experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) / Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD FX-8350 / Intel Core i5-4430
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 580 / GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Medium 1080p @ 45 FPS, DX12, Ray Tracing OFF ・Framerate might drop in graphics-intensive scenes. ・ (subject to change)
